content:
📬 Trunk & Tidbits for July 2026 is now out!

Our monthly blog post series is there to showcase what we worked on last month.

In this edition, we welcome @jhbabon and highlight the many backend changes that were merged and will be part of our upcoming 4.7 release. Those include support for FEP-8b32, FEP 8967 and new algorithms, including ML-DSA-44 for post-quantum signatures.

https://blog.joinmastodon.org/2026/08/trunk-tidbits-july-2026/
